rationale.oversight-theater: Defines rubber-stamp review lacking authority, information, time, and practical influence.
rationale.automation-bias: Substantively analyzes model deference, reviewer fatigue, and declining intervention quality.
rationale.risk-routing: Operationalizes independent risk triggers, review tiers, thresholds, and escalation SLAs.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Designs role-based override authority and intervention before irreversible execution.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Provides reviewers decision-ready reasons, uncertainty, provenance, and contextual guidance.
rationale.org-governance: Specifies roles, audit routines, QA, accountability, and continuous control improvement.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Maps controls and evidence to ISO-style and external risk frameworks.
rationale.framework: Offers a reusable intervention architecture spanning controls, metrics, and operating governance.
rationale.design-only: Specifies buildable controls and thresholds without implementation or intended-object evaluation.
rationale.general-ai: Targets automated AI decisions across credit, hiring, and healthcare, not coding.
rationale.metrics: Defines over-reliance indicators including overrides, escalation precision, latency, and drift.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Contributes controls and measurements addressing excessive human dependence on model judgments.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes checkbox HITL compliance and nominal human approval as genuine oversight.
